title: Phone won't power off during interview

tellings.quote: Let's document all of this. You can see my finger is on the power button

plain: During an interview in the UK in 2026, Jesse Michels says his phone would not switch off, and he filmed his finger pressing the power button to prove it. He tells this himself, as something that happened to him while talking with Gary McKinnon, a British hacker who says he found signs of a secret space programme in NASA computers. Michels presents it as a strange glitch worth documenting given who he was talking to.
